title.ja: 図1-1 対振り飛車の基本形
title.en: Figure 1-1: Basic form against Ranging Rook

explain.ja: 図1-1は対振り飛車の基本形です。この形からポンポン桂を目指します。
explain.en: Diagram 1-1 is the basic form against Ranging Rook. We aim for the Pon-Pon Knight from this form.

title.ja: 図1-2 舟囲いに手を付ける
title.en: Figure 1-2: Start on the Boat castle

explain.ja: ポンポン桂では、すぐに仕掛けずにまず舟囲いに手をつけます。▲6八金まで組めば駒組みも最終段階です。
explain.en: In the Pon-Pon Knight you don't attack immediately but first build the Boat castle. Once ▲6八金 is played, the development is in its final stage.

section.ja: 舟囲いに手を付けていく

line.text: △7二玉、▲2五歩、△8二玉、▲3六歩、△7二銀、▲6八銀、△5二金左、▲5七銀左、△9四歩、▲9六歩、△4三銀、▲6八金上、△5四歩

title.ja: 図1-3 桂馬を跳ねて攻めの準備
title.en: Figure 1-3: Jump the knight to prepare the attack

explain.ja: ▲3七桂と桂馬を跳ねて攻めの準備をします。ポンポン桂という名前のとおり、この桂馬が攻めのカギです。左の桂馬をポンポンと跳ねて攻めていきます。
explain.en: Jump the knight to ▲3七桂 to prepare the attack. As the name Pon-Pon Knight suggests, this knight is the key to the attack. The left knight is jumped out repeatedly to attack.

section.en: Prepare the attack by jumping the knight to ▲3七

title.ja: 図2-1 いきなり桂馬を捨てるのが仕掛け
title.en: Figure 2-1: Sacrificing the knight right away is the attack

explain.ja: いきなり▲4五桂と桂馬をただで捨てるのがポンポン桂の基本の仕掛けです。さらに手を進めて攻めの狙いを見ます。
explain.en: Sacrificing the knight for nothing immediately with ▲4五桂 is the basic attack of the Pon-Pon Knight. Continue to see the aim of the attack.

section.ja: いきなり桂馬を捨てて仕掛ける
section.en: Start the attack by sacrificing the knight right away

title.ja: 図2-2 角交換して2筋を突破
title.en: Figure 2-2: Exchange bishops and break through the 2nd file

explain.ja: ▲4五桂に△同歩と桂を取れば相手の角道が開くので、角交換を仕掛けます。角交換すれば▲2四歩から飛車先を突破できます。無理やり角交換して攻めをつなげるのです。
explain.en: If White takes the knight with △同歩 after ▲4五桂, the opponent's bishop diagonal opens, so Black offers a bishop exchange. After the exchange, ▲2四歩 breaks through on the rook file. You force the bishop exchange and keep the attack connected.

section.en: Exchange bishops and break through on the 2nd file

line.text: △4五歩、▲3三角成、△同桂、▲2四歩、△同歩、▲同飛

title.ja: 図2-3 ポンポン桂の攻めが成功

explain.ja: 飛車先突破に△2二歩などと受けてくれば、▲3一角で攻めがつながります。相手の飛車が逃げれば▲2二角成です。
explain.en: If White defends against the breakthrough with something like △2二歩, ▲3一角 keeps the attack connected. If the opponent's rook runs, ▲2二角成.

section.en: Exchange bishops and break through on the 2nd file

title.ja: 図2-4 △4一飛からじっくり受けられる
title.en: Figure 2-4: Can defend carefully with △4一飛

explain.ja: 図2-2に戻って別の指し手を見ます。ここでは△4一飛と引いてくるのがうまい受けで、▲2二飛に△4二金とされるとポンポン桂側は攻め手がなくなります。
explain.en: Return to Diagram 2-2 and see another move. Here retreating with △4一飛 is a clever defense, and if ▲2二飛 is met by △4二金, the Pon-Pon Knight side runs out of attacking moves.

section.ja: △4一飛からじっくり受けられると不利に...
section.en: If White defends patiently from △4一飛, it becomes unfavorable...

title.ja: 図2-6 何とか攻めを繋ぐ
title.en: Figure 2-6: Somehow keep the attack going

explain.ja: 図2-2から△4一飛と受けられた場合は、▲6六角などでどうにか攻めをつなげましょう。ここからもまだ互角の戦いが続きます。ポンポン桂は桂損してから攻める戦法なので、何としても攻めをつながないと桂馬を損しただけになります。
explain.en: If White defends with △4一飛 from Diagram 2-2, somehow connect the attack with something like ▲6六角. The fight remains even from here. The Pon-Pon Knight attacks after sacrificing the knight, so unless the attack is kept connected you merely lose a knight.

section.ja: 角打ちから攻めを繋げていく
section.en: Connect the attack from a bishop drop

title.ja: 図3-1 さっきとほとんど同じだが…
title.en: Figure 3-1: Almost the same as before, but...

explain.ja: 図1-3に戻り、ポンポン桂がうまくいかないパターンを見ます。相手が△6四歩と突く手を保留して別の手を指してきた場合、ポンポン桂の攻めは成立しません。
explain.en: Return to Diagram 1-3 and see a pattern in which the Pon-Pon Knight fails. If the opponent holds back △6四歩 and plays another move, the Pon-Pon Knight attack does not work.

section.ja: 相手が△6四歩と突いていないと...
section.en: If the opponent has not played △6四歩...

explain.ja: 角交換して▲2四歩と突いたタイミングで△6四角と打つのが、四間飛車側の切り返しです。こうなるとポンポン桂側が不利になるので、ポンポン桂で仕掛ける前に、相手が△6四歩と突いたことを確認してから攻めるようにしましょう。相手が△6四歩と突いていれば、△6四角と打たれる心配はありません。
explain.en: When bishops are exchanged and ▲2四歩 is pushed, the Fourth File Rook side's counter is the bishop drop △6四角. That makes the Pon-Pon Knight side worse, so before attacking with it, confirm that the opponent has pushed △6四歩. If the opponent has pushed △6四歩, there is no worry about a △6四角 drop.

section.ja: ポンポン桂の仕掛けは△6四角の角打ちが切り返しに
section.en: Against the Pon-Pon Knight attack, the △6四角 bishop drop is the counter

title.ja: 図3-3 4五歩早仕掛けに切り替える
title.en: Figure 3-3: Switch to the 4五歩 early attack

explain.ja: 図1-3に戻ります。相手がポンポン桂を警戒して△6四歩を保留してきた場合は、4五歩早仕掛けを狙うのがおすすめです。▲4五歩で相手の角道をこじ開け、角交換から2筋突破を狙います。
explain.en: Return to Diagram 1-3. If the opponent wary of the Pon-Pon Knight holds back △6四歩, aiming for the 4五-pawn early attack is recommended. Force open the opponent's bishop line with ▲4五歩 and aim for a breakthrough on the 2nd file via a bishop exchange.

section.ja: ポンポン桂がうまくいかないときは4五歩早仕掛けに
section.en: If the Pon-Pon Knight does not work, switch to the early 4五歩 attack
